title: This mall dream never faded — curious if others have similar ones
content: I dreamt of this mall years ago…I think. Sometimes it’s so vivid and I wonder if I dreamt of it more recently. I wish I wrote it down when I actually had the dream. I’m in the car driving towards this mall, and it appears in the distance—emphasis on the big red slide. I feel excited! There’s a part in the dream where I’m in the mall food court and the escalators are near the red spiral slide. I don’t remember much else and wonder the symbolism. I’ve also had many other mall dreams—this is just one of them that has stuck out.
